Top-level keys of a scaffold.yaml document.

| Key | Type | Default | Effect | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | — | Implemented | Name of the workspace. Becomes the output directory name. |
| `version` | string | — | Implemented | Semantic version of the configuration, for example `1.0.0`. |
| `description` | string | — | Implemented | Free-text description. |
| `outputPath` | string | `.` | Implemented | Path inserted between `--output` and the workspace directory. |
| `globalVariables` | map<string, string> | — | Implemented | Values available to every project. |
| `gitInit` | bool | `false` | No effect | Requests a Git repository in the output directory. **See KL-004.** |
| `postScaffoldCommands` | string[] | — | Implemented | Shell commands run in the output root after files are written. |
| `solutions` | solution[] | — | Implemented | Solution files to create. |
| `projects` | project[] | — | Implemented | Projects to create. At least one is required. |

:::note[Not yet implemented]
**`gitInit` has no effect.** The key is accepted by the schema and validated. No repository is created.

Run `git init` in the output directory yourself, or add it to `postScaffoldCommands`.

_Tracked as [KL-004](/reference/known-limitations/#kl-004) · Applies to CLI 1.2.1_
:::
